translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Tegin an takchabaldo, Pab-neggin immal-keger-takleged oyolenonibal. Tenal immal-keger-taklegeddin angelmal-walakugled chogakugle napi poni-cheinonikid. Imi we poni chogakugledgin Pab Tummad napi tule-iti-napkin-pukmalad-oturdajal, Pab Tummad wejego tule-iti-napkin-pukmalad-oturdako, tule-pal-kwen-oturdakojul-kuo.

Tegin an takchabal, immal-termalyob-takle nai, tenal purtikidyob tegin choyob taklebal. Tegin termalyob-takleged-kakabal, tulemal-pinasgin-tegin-eyob-chobaledgin-nakwismalad tegin tule-pinas-numero-nug-wilubgin-nazhiszhulmalad, termal-kakabal kwigwismal. Tegin Pab tulemal-pinasgin-nakwismaladga kal-arpa ukcha, al tulemal-pinasgin-nakwismalad kal-arpa kani-nemal.
Tegin we tulemal Pab-Tummad-e-mos-Moisés-namakedgin tegin Oveja-chapini-namakedgin namakalmal, chogalmal:

content.text: Tegin pedin napírra ilagwen immal ima,

content: Tegin an we immalmal takchad-cholbal, an takchabal, Pab-neggin Pab-maid-neg arkat, tenal we neg nugbal Pab-kaka-ukchad-neg.
Tegin Pab-maid-neg-akar angelmal-walakugle poni-chogakugle-nikmalad nononimal. Tenal we angelmal mol-chibu-is-is-kaed-pane-chabingiid yoyomal, tenal twisgalgin ol-tub nanimalbal.
Tegin immal-tulgan-walbakegwad-walgwendin, angel-walakugledga ol-muruk-kwakugled ukcha. Imi we ol-muruk-kwakugledgin Pab-ilagwen-nadgu-tulad, tule-oturdakoed taka-taka chiji-nad.
Tegin Pab-maid-neggin Pab-kannaleged tegin Pab-nugu-takleged, wayob pel-kwapa neg kas. Tenal angel-walakugled-poni-chogakugled-nikad, pél immal imajulmalal, tule Pab-maid-neggin keg togmal.
